name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Multi-line text input for notes, requests and longer answers.

props.name: optional
props.description: Adds a muted "(Optional)" after the label: the `optional` label.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the field invalid without one.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The new text, and the change event for code that needs the caret or input method state (`usePromptMentions`).

props.name: underlay
props.description: Drawn under the text, inside the field and unclipped: `usePromptMentions().overlay`. The field's fill moves to a layer under it and the textarea turns transparent.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint row). `className` styles the field.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

CharacterCount.description: A character counter, the one under Textarea: "134/120" against a limit, in text/destructive once over it, with "Characters used:" before it for screen readers; or, with no limit, the count in words ("948 characters", the `characterCount` label, the number written in `dateLocale`). Muted 14px by default, set to stay on one line at the end of a hint row. It isn't a live region (it changes on every key); point the field's `aria-describedby` at its `id`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `p`.

props.name: max
props.description: The limit. With it the count reads "134/120"; without it, "948 characters".
